title: Barracuda ESG Authentication Bypass Flaw Opens Path to Root
description: Two vulnerabilities in Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) appliances can be chained to gain root access. The first is an authentication bypass (CVE-2026-116606) allowing unauthenticated attackers to restore crafted backups and modify global configuration. The second is a command injection flaw (CVE-2026-111560) in the timezone configuration, exploitable by authenticated administrators to execute OS commands as root. The command injection also affects five other Barracuda products. Exploitation requires access to the appliance's administrative interface. Barracuda has released patches and advises restricting admin interface access to trusted internal networks.
